A '''Survey Frigate''' was a type of starship used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Survey Team]]s to travel to the various [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and [[Moon/Legends|moons]] the team investigated. It carried crew, vehicles and equipment needed to launch survey missions.

[[IX3244-B]], the Survey Team to discover the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of Endor]], launched their operation from an orbiting Survey Frigate.
